title: Compare shared and per-function bindings
description: You follow the loop variable through a shared binding, a default argument, and a factory function.

steps.description: You append lambdas that read i when called. Each function refers to the same loop variable.

steps.question: Which value does each function read when the first list comprehension calls it?
steps.answer: Each reads the final i value, 4. The Broken output repeats that value.

steps.description: You give each lambda a default parameter with i=i. Python evaluates that default when the function is created, preserving each iteration's value.
You call make_adder for each loop value. Each call gives the returned lambda its own n binding.
You reach the factory version's print. Fixed1 and Fixed2 both print [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], while Broken repeats 4.
